mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review (rv_id, m_id, contentid, rv_content, rv_rating, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (seq_review.NEXTVAL, #{mId}, #{contentid}, #{rvContent}, #{rvRating}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT r.rv_id AS rvId, r.m_id AS mId, r.contentid, r.rv_content AS rvContent, r.rv_rating AS rvRating, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.updated_at AS updatedAt, m.m_nickname AS memberNickname FROM review r JOIN member m ON r.m_id = m.m_id WHERE r.rv_id = #{rvId}

SELECT r.rv_id AS rvId, r.m_id AS mId, r.contentid, r.rv_content AS rvContent, r.rv_rating AS rvRating, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.updated_at AS updatedAt, m.m_nickname AS memberNickname FROM review r JOIN member m ON r.m_id = m.m_id WHERE r.contentid = #{contentid} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC

SELECT r.rv_id AS rvId, r.m_id AS mId, r.contentid, r.rv_content AS rvContent, r.rv_rating AS rvRating, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.updated_at AS updatedAt, d.title AS destinationTitle, d.firstimage AS destinationImage FROM review r JOIN destination d ON r.contentid = d.contentid WHERE r.m_id = #{mId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE review SET rv_content = #{rvContent}, rv_rating = #{rvRating}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE rv_id = #{rvId}
